content: Rien Sosep kan Pwuralahng Isip Iangahki Pensamin
Lehk lapalapo nan Kenan inenen uklahr mehlel,
eri, ni peneinei en Seikop ko ar tungoalelahr wahn kohn ko, me re wahdo sang Isip, Seikop ahpw ndaiong nah pwutak ko, “Kumwail pwurala oh pwurehng pwainda atail tungoal kisin mwenge.”
Suda ahpw sapeng eh pahpao, nda, “Ohlo kehlehlingkihong kiht ni kehlail, me se sohte pahn kak tuhwong ma riato sohte iang kiht.
Ma ke mweidohng riato en iang kiht, eri, se pahn kohdihla oh pwainda omw tungoal wahn kohn.
A ma ke sohte men mweidohng, eri se sohte pahn kohdihla, pwe ohlo mahsanihong kiht, me se sohte pahn tuhwong ma riato sohte iang kiht.’”
Seikop ahpw nda, “Pwe dahme kumwail pil ndakihong ohlo me mie emen riamwail? Kumwail inenen kihong ie nan apwal.”

A re sapeng, nda, “Pwe ohlo idihdekte reht duwen oaretik en atail peneinei, ‘Amwail pahpao momourte? Mie pil emen riamwail?’ Eri, se uhdahn pahn sapeng eh peidek ko. Pala se kak ese me e pahn mahsanihong kiht se en wahla riato?”
Suda ahpw ndaiong eh pahpao, “Mweidohng pwutaken en iangiehda, pwe se en mwesel kohkohla, pwe emen kitail de mehkihla duhpek.
I pahn pangala pein ei mour, oh ngehi me pahn pwukoahki. Ma I sohte kapwurehdo, eri, I pahn dipada ong komwi kohkohlahte.
Kitail kauwelahr atail ahnsou, mahk kitail lelehr mwo oh pwurodohr pahn pak riapak.”
Arail pahpao eri ndaiong irail, “Eri, ma ih pahn duwe met, a kumwail audekihda amwail ehd kan wahnsahpw me keieu kaselel oh wahwei kisikisehki kepinao.
Kumwail pil kalaudehla pak riapak uwen mwohni me kumwail pahn wa kohwei, oh kapwurehla mwohni me kumwail diar nan amwail ehd ko. Mweinele sapwungala ieu men.
Kumwail pil kahrehda riamwailet oh kumwail pil mwadang pwurodo.

Koht Wasa Lapalap en ketin kupwure pwe kumwail en diar kalahngan rehn ohlo, pwe en kapwuredohng kumwail Pensamin oh riamwail teio, a ngehi, ma I sepwoupwoulahr solahr nei seri, so mehn wiawi, I pahn kanengamahiong.”
Pwihn pirieno eri ale arail mehn kisakis ko oh uwen mwohni laud pak riapak, oh iangahki Pensamin; re ahpw mwesel kohdilahng Isip pwe re en tuhwong Sosep.

Ni Sosep eh mahsanihada me Pensamin iang irail, e ahpw mahsanihong sapwellime kaunen papah ko, “Kahrehla pwihno ni imweio, ke ahpw kemehla emen mahn en oh onopada pwe re pahn iang ie tungoal nin souwaset.”
Kaunen papah ko eri kapwaiada mehkoaros me koasoandiong en wiawi, e ahpw kahreirailla nan tehnpas en Sosepo.

Ni ar pedolong nan tehnpaso, re inenen masepwehkada, re ahpw mengimengloalki, “Kitail pakahrdohngehr wasaht pwehki mwohni ko me kapwurupwurlong nan atail ehd ko nin tapio. Re pahn kemeikitail, adihasang kitail neitail ahs akan oh kaliduwihkitailla.”
Irail eri keilahng mpen kaunen papah ko oh lokaiaiong ni wenihmwen tehnpaso.
Re patohwanohng, “Maing, komw kupwur mahk, pak ehu se patohwan pwarodohr wasakiset pwe se en pwainda at tungoal kisin mwenge.
Ahpw ni at lel wasahn kommoal oh keiruhdi ie, se sapwadpeseng at tungoal ehd ko, oh diarada nan ewen en emenemen eh ehd mwohni ko. Se patohwan kapwurehdo koaros.
Se pil iangahki mwohni mehn pwainda pil ekei mwenge. Se sohte patohwan ihs me kihdiong mwohni ko nan at tungoal ehd ko.”

Papaho ahpw ndaiong irail, “Kumwail dehr pwunod, kumwail dehr masak. Mweinele amwail Koht, Koht en samamwailo me ketikihong kumwail mwohni pwukan nan amwail ehd kan. I aleier pweinen kanamwail mwenge ko.” E ahpw kahreiei Simion rehrail.
Papaho eri kahrehlong pirieno nan tehnpas en Sosep. E ahpw kihong irail pihl mehn widen nehrail ko, oh e pil kamwenge neirail ahs ako.
Irail eri kaunopada arail kisakis ko mwohn Sosep eh pahn lelodo nin souwas, pwe re rongada me re pahn iang Sosep saken souwas.
Ni Sosep eh lelodo, re ahpw walahng kisakis ko, oh poaridi mwowe lel nanpwel.
Sosep eri idek ia irarail oh pil mahsanih, “Kumwail koasoiaiong ie mahs duwen amwail pahpa ohl laudo, a ia ire? E momourte oh e me kehlail?”
Re sapeng, “Ei maing, sapwellimomwi ladu sohwar, at tungoal pahpa, momourte oh e me kehlail.” Re ahpw kelehpwkihdi oh poaridi mwowe.
Ni Sosep eh kilangada rie Pensamin e ahpw idek, “Ih riamwail me tikitiko met me kumwail koasoiaiong ie duwe?” Ih eri mahsanihong, “Koht en ketin kupwuramwahwihiuk, samwa.”
E ahpw mwadangete ketiketla sang irail, pwe nan kupwure mwekidikihda e poakohng rie ko, e ahpw solahr itarohng, ih eri ketilongala nan eh pere oh tentenihr ie.
Mwurin eh epwinekda, e ahpw ketieila oh nantihong kanengamahiong pepehm en nan kupwure, ih eri mahsanih sak en wiawihla.
Sosep ket ni ehu tehpel a rie ko ni ehu. Mehn Isip ko me iang kepin sako pil pato ni ehu tehpel, pwe re kin wiahki mehkot kanamenek oh kasaroh iang mehn Ipru kan mwohdehng ni ehu tehpel.

Pirieno ahpw mwohndiong ni tehpel sallahng Sosep, me meseniho mahs, mwuhri meteiko nin duwen irekidien sounpararail ko, lao lel me keieu tikitiko. Ni ar tehkada duwen koasoandi en ar mohndio, re ahpw inenen pwuriamweikihla.
Re audehda neirail dahl ako sang ni en Sosep tehpelo, oh en Pensamin eh tungoalo inenen laudsang en meteiko pak limau. Irail eri iang ih sakasak oh pereperen kowahlap.
